title: AZ-900 · Describe Azure storage services · Summary

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure storage account?

options.text: A resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints
A Blob Storage tier optimized for infrequently accessed data generally stored for at least 30 days
GZRS with read access to the secondary-region copy before failover
AzCopy synchronization that copies changes from a designated source toward a destination rather than maintaining two-way sync

questions.explanation: Azure storage account is a resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Standard general-purpose v2 refer to?

options.text: A premium account type for Azure Files that supports SMB and NFS shares
The globally unique account name used as part of Azure Storage service endpoints
The recommended standard account type for most blob, file, queue, and table storage scenarios
Keeping frequently accessed files locally while allowing less-used files to remain primarily in Azure

questions.explanation: Standard general-purpose v2 is the recommended standard account type for most blob, file, queue, and table storage scenarios.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.question: Which description correctly matches Premium block blobs?

options.text: Using Azure File Sync to retain fast local access while centralizing file shares in Azure Files
LRS in the primary region plus asynchronous replication to LRS in a paired secondary region
A premium account type for block and append blobs requiring high transaction rates or low latency
A resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints

questions.explanation: Premium block blobs is a premium account type for block and append blobs requiring high transaction rates or low latency.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.question: Which of the following is the best definition of Premium file shares?

options.text: A premium account type for Azure Files that supports SMB and NFS shares

An endpoint using the storage account name with the blob.core.windows.net service domain
The lowest-cost storage tier for rarely accessed data with the highest retrieval latency and a long intended retention period

questions.explanation: Premium file shares is a premium account type for Azure Files that supports SMB and NFS shares.

Azure storage account: a premium account type for Azure Files that supports SMB and NFS shares.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.question: Choose the TWO accurate statements.

options.text: Locally redundant storage (LRS): ZRS in the primary region plus asynchronous replication to LRS in a secondary region.
Locally redundant storage (LRS): replication of data three times within a single datacenter in the primary region.
Storage account naming rule: GZRS with read access to the secondary-region copy before failover.
Zone-redundant storage (ZRS): synchronous replication across three availability zones in the primary region.
Zone-redundant storage (ZRS): the point in time to which data can be recovered, reflecting possible lag in asynchronous replication.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Locally redundant storage (LRS) — replication of data three times within a single datacenter in the primary region; and Zone-redundant storage (ZRS) — synchronous replication across three availability zones in the primary region.
